title: A filter on another column of the filtering table reaches the other table through the values of the related column

source.quote: because the color blue is used by products from two categories, those categories are used to filter the targets
source.supports: the page describes this model shape: the categories of the products in the filter are what filters Target

derivation: Green is the T-shirt, category Clothing: 100 + 120 = 220. Blue is Jeans (Clothing) and Hat (Accessories): both categories filter Target: 220 + 110 = 330.
